title: Arcjet
description_en: Secure the AI agents you're building at runtime. Arcjet is the runtime security platform that ships in your AI code. Detect prompt injection, authorize agent tool calls, redact sensitive data, and block bots and abuse. Real-time security building blocks you call inside your app, before an action happens.
description_zh: Arcjet是一个专为AI Agent设计的运行时安全平台，以SDK形式直接嵌入开发者的AI代码中。核心功能包括：①实时检测prompt injection攻击 ②授权和监控agent的工具调用行为 ③自动识别和脱敏敏感数据（PII/API密钥等）④阻止bot和滥用行为。与传统安全产品的关键差异在于它在action发生前就在应用内部进行拦截，而非事后审计。目标用户是正在构建AI Agent的开发者和企业，尤其是那些需要将agent部署到生产环境、面临真实安全风险的团队。Product Hunt获得250票和5.0满分评价显示开发者社区有明确需求认可。

title: Hyrax AI
description_en: The AI architect for your entire codebase. Code review tools tell you what’s wrong with a PR. Hyrax finds what should improve across your entire codebase and does the work. It builds deep context around your architecture and conventions, prioritizes issues across six engineering domains, writes each fix in context, verifies it against your tests and checks, and opens a GitHub PR for your team to review and merge.
description_zh: Hyrax AI定位为'AI架构师'，解决传统Code Review工具只能被动检查PR问题的痛点。产品核心能力：①深度理解整个代码库的架构和编码规范 ②主动扫描六大工程领域（架构、性能、安全、可维护性等）的潜在问题 ③按优先级排序问题 ④自动编写修复代码并通过测试验证 ⑤直接提交GitHub PR供团队审核合并。这是从'被动检查单个PR'到'主动优化整个代码库'的范式转变，目标用户是需要持续重构和技术债管理的中大型工程团队。Product Hunt获180票显示中等市场关注度，但缺乏用户数、付费转化等关键数据。

title: Termphin
description_en: SSH client with sessions that never drop.. SSH that survives a locked phone, a lost signal or a switch to mobile data. A small agent holds the shell open on the server and puts you back on the same screen. htop and vim draw properly. SFTP, keys, snippets and tunnels included, free.
description_zh: Termphin是一款Android SSH客户端，核心创新在于解决移动端SSH连接不稳定的痛点。传统SSH在手机锁屏、网络切换（WiFi↔移动数据）或信号丢失时会断开连接，Termphin通过在服务器端部署小型agent程序，持续保持shell会话存活，客户端重连后可立即恢复到之前的屏幕状态。产品支持htop、vim等终端工具的正确渲染，内置SFTP文件传输、SSH密钥管理、命令片段（snippets）和端口转发（tunnels）功能。目前完全免费提供，主要面向需要在移动设备上进行服务器运维的开发者和系统管理员。Product Hunt获得125票，属于中等关注度，无评论数据，话题标签为Android、生产力工具和开发者工具。

full_profile.overview_zh: Termphin是一款Android SSH客户端，核心创新在于解决移动端SSH连接不稳定的痛点。传统SSH在手机锁屏、网络切换（WiFi↔移动数据）或信号丢失时会断开连接，Termphin通过在服务器端部署小型agent程序，持续保持shell会话存活，客户端重连后可立即恢复到之前的屏幕状态。产品支持htop、vim等终端工具的正确渲染，内置SFTP文件传输、SSH密钥管理、命令片段（snippets）和端口转发（tunnels）功能。目前完全免费提供，主要面向需要在移动设备上进行服务器运维的开发者和系统管理员。Product Hunt获得125票，属于中等关注度，无评论数据，话题标签为Android、生产力工具和开发者工具。

full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：这是一个典型的'开发者工具优化'项目，而非AI-native创新。市场被低估之处在于移动端SSH的刚需场景（紧急运维、远程办公）确实存在，但市场规模有限且已有成熟竞品（Termux、Blink Shell、Prompt）。Alpha机会微弱，因为：①技术壁垒低，session持久化方案（如tmux/screen over SSH）已是成熟技术②无AI能力加持，无法形成数据飞轮③免费策略下难以构建商业护城河。主要风险：①竞品可快速复制核心功能②开源替代方案丰富③变现路径不清晰可能导致项目难以持续。不符合我们'AI Native + 高壁垒'的投资论文，更像是一个执行层面
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得8分：产品完全没有AI能力，是传统SSH客户端的功能优化，仅通过服务端agent实现会话持久化，无任何机器学习、自然语言交互或智能化特性，属于'AI仅作装饰'级别（实际连装饰都没有）。Niche得16分：解决了移动端SSH断线的真实痛点，在Android SSH客户端这个细分市场有一定场景护城河，但技术方案（session持久化）并非独创，tmux/screen等工具已广泛应用，可替代性较高，壁垒较弱。商业模式得6分：当前完全免费，无明确变现计划，商业逻辑不清晰，长期可持续性存疑。团队得9分：仅知Maker为hawierdev，无背景信息，无法判断技术深度或领域经验，信息严重不足。减3分：信息严重不足（团队背景、用户数据、技术细节均缺失），难以全面评判项目潜力。

description_en: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.

title: slop-grader
description_en: Jev-AI CLI tool that evaluates text against custom rulesets. slop-grader is a rule-based CLI tool that evaluates documents against custom rulesets and produces document scores and line-by-line flags to guide auto-fixing with an AI agent. Use it to catch AI filler in launch copy, to strip buzzwords from landing pages, score narrative flow in launch emails. Flagged lines let agents draft sharper copy. The tool flags outputs prompts so agents can draft fixes.
description_zh: slop-grader是一个命令行工具，通过自定义规则集评估文档质量，主要用于检测AI生成文本中的冗余表达（AI slop）、营销套话和buzzwords。工具会对文档进行评分，并逐行标记问题内容，输出可供AI Agent使用的prompt来自动修复这些问题。典型应用场景包括：检查产品发布文案中的AI填充内容、清理落地页的营销术语、评估发布邮件的叙事流畅度。其核心价值在于作为AI写作工作流的质量控制层，让Agent能够基于具体标记生成更精准的改进版本。产品目前在Product Hunt获得84票，属于开源项目，有GitHub主题标签。

description_en: The agent that buys the right gift on time, every time. Generous is the first AI agent for gifting. title: RBS-Attention: Radius-Bounded Sparse Prefill for Long-Context Large Language Models
description_en: arXiv:2609.20971v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-context large language model inference is increasingly limited by prefill, where dense self-attention processes the entire prompt before generation begins. Sparse block selection can reduce this cost, but a block centroid may hide a highly relevant token among many irrelevant ones. We call this failure mode mean dilution and propose RBS-Attention, a training-free sparse-prefill method with two complementary selection branches. title: Jev
description_en: Fast, structured AI decisions for software automation. Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Now available to everyone at console.typesafe.ai with no waitlist.

title: Sai
description_en: The autonomous computer fleet at your command. Sai is the world's first robosecretary that works with a fleet of autonomous computers, doing your endless screen work. Each computer navigates software the way you do: reads the screen, clicks the button, types in the form. Trained to interact with the computer interface, Sai automates software even when they lack APIs: legacy desktop apps, internal portals, anything behind a login. Sai supports Windows, macOS and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.

title: Jevtown
description_en: 10,000 AI readers react to your post before you publish it. Write a post, a listing, a product or a headline, and 10,000 computed AI residents read it. The 600 it should matter to see it first, and it reaches the next 1,500 only if more readers were glad than annoyed, so a weak text dies for half a cent and a good one reaches everyone in 14 seconds. You get who stopped, liked, reposted or blocked, by interest, job, age, city and budget; the questions buyers would ask a listing first; and a demand curve over a product's price ladder. No sign-in.

title: Milliseconds.ai
description_en: Fast AI decisions on text and images, via one API. Text and images in. Labels, categories, structured fields and decisions out. Meet decision-machine-1, the small model behind milliseconds.ai. Route emails, extract invoice data, apply return policies (or build your hot-dog identification empire). One fast API. $0.04 per million input tokens. Output tokens are free. Get 125M free input tokens every month on test keys.

title: Simha Digital
description_en: SEO workspace that tells you what to fix with a plan. Simha is an SEO workspace that tells you what to fix, not just what's wrong. Connect Search Console and Analytics, run a crawl — and get one health score, a plan ordered by traffic at stake, and an AI summary of what changed and why. Then the part no other tool has: we ask AI search engines your key queries and show whether ChatGPT-style answers cite your site, and who gets cited instead. Growth points, Core Web Vitals, an assistant that knows your data. 7 days free.

title: NiubiGEO
description_en: Open-source AI visibility. Human-powered growth.. NiubiGEO combines open-source AI visibility and competitor reports with human-powered product growth. See how AI describes your product, which competitors appear, and inspect original answers and sources. Arrange paid human AI testing, product trials, content creation and distribution through the official platform. Plan tasks and budgets with Growth Canvas, then retest AI visibility. Self-hosted software is free; API, hosting and services cost extra.

title: Awnsy
description_en: Offline AI translator for Mac. Press ⌘C twice, done.. Awnsy is a small menu bar translator for macOS. Select text in any app, press ⌘C twice, and the translation appears right over the window. For text you can't select, like images, scanned PDFs or video, drag a box around it and Awnsy reads and translates it. The translation model lives inside the app and runs on your Mac. No account, no API key, works offline, and what you translate stays on your machine. If you prefer cloud quality, add your own OpenAI or Anthropic key.
